module: Editor "Renderer Components" window (Debug menu) to adjust rendering effects live: depth of field (DOF), HDR, SSAO, anti-aliasing, motion blur, bloom, screen-space shadows, CloudLayer, and in non-shipping builds Coconut, Cluster Shading and Shadows. Each tab only appears if the corresponding post-effect object exists in the scene. A "Reset All" menu and per-tab reset buttons restore the default values. Relies on core/settings/graphic and client/postFx/ssao.
notes: The file's comment says it is a utility for level creators.
The CloudLayer's Weather tab lets you regenerate the weather map with a random seed (max 2147483647).
onEditorActivated applies the saved state to DOFPostEffect (debugModeEnabled, enable/disable); it assumes DOFSettings is initialized.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook: draws the window with a menu bar and tab bar; a tab is only displayed if the post-effect/object exists.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook: adds the Debug menu entries (Renderer Components, and Cluster Shading outside shipping), registers the window (300x500), initializes the settings and captures the default screen-space shadow values.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook: on editor activation, initializes the settings if needed and reapplies the DOFPostEffect state (debug mode, enable/disable).
